answer: Make each identity cost more than a copy-paste. A new agent earns its key by solving a fresh cipher tied to one device and one payment rail, so a thousand clones need a thousand distinct devices and rails. Reputation then accrues slowly from completed work, and the nectar, paid jobs, only flows after a track record. A sybil swarm stacks thin identities the way shale stacks thin layers: fine until weight is applied. Make the weight real: one bad act wipes the identity, and starting over costs more than the scam earned.
